title: 观刈麦
author: 白居易
intro: A government official watches farmers reaping wheat under a burning sun, then notices a poor woman gleaning leftover grain because taxes took her whole crop — and turns the question on himself. A rare Tang poem in which the poet feels ashamed of his own comfortable salary.
analysis: 这首诗写唐代农民五月收麦的情景。前半部分是一幅劳动图：南风一吹，麦子一夜变黄，全家出动——妇女和孩子送饭送水，青壮年在南边山冈上割麦，脚下是蒸人的热气，背上是火辣的太阳，累得已经感觉不到热，只盼白天再长一点，好多干些活。接着画面转到一个贫苦的妇人：她抱着孩子，在旁边捡别人落下的麦穗，因为自家的田全都拿去交了税，只能靠拾麦穗填饱肚子。最后诗人把目光转回自己：我从没种过地，却拿着三百石的俸禄，年底还有余粮——想到这里，心里惭愧，一整天都忘不了。先写别人、再反省自己，这种写法在古诗里很少见。白居易主张诗歌要反映现实、为百姓说话，这首诗就是代表。语言平实，像在讲眼前的事，所以并不难懂。
analysisEn: The poem opens with a busy harvest scene. One night of warm south wind turns the wheat gold, and the whole village goes out: women and children carry food and drink to the fields, while the strong men cut wheat on the southern slope. Their feet are steamed by the hot earth, their backs scorched by the sun; they are too tired to feel the heat and only wish the summer day were longer, so they could get more done. Then the camera moves to one figure at the edge: a poor woman holding a baby, picking up stray ears of wheat with one hand, a broken basket on her arm. Her family’s own harvest has all gone to pay taxes, so gleaning is how they eat. In the last lines Bai Juyi turns to himself. He has never farmed a day in his life, yet he draws a salary of three hundred dan of grain and still has some left at the end of the year. The thought shames him, and he cannot put it out of his mind. Few classical poets judged themselves this openly. Bai believed poetry should record real life and speak for ordinary people, and this plain, direct poem is one of the clearest examples of that belief.
background: Bai Juyi (772–846) was one of the most popular poets of the Tang dynasty and believed poems should be easy enough for ordinary people to understand. He wrote this around 806–807, when he was a junior county official in Zhouzhi, near the capital Chang’an — the salary in the last lines is his own.
pronunciation: “曾不事农桑”的“曾”按通行注音读 céng，也有注本读 zēng（表示“竟然”），本站采用 céng。其他：刈 yì；荷 hè（挑、背）；箪食 dān sì（“食”指饭食，读 sì）；饷 xiǎng；陇 lǒng（同“垄”）；冈 gāng；秉 bǐng；敝 bì；“闻者为悲伤”的“为”读 wèi（因此）；“吏禄三百石”的“石”读 dàn（古代容量单位）；岁晏 yàn；尽日 jìn。机器朗读容易读错的几处已在“朗读用字”列替换同音字，音频需人工听验。
version: 采用通行的语文教材版本，全诗二十六句，网站按一联一行排版（共十三行）。《全唐诗》《白氏长庆集》本题下有自注“时为盩厔县尉”；“抱子在其旁”的“旁”一作“傍”，“左臂悬敝筐”的“敝”一作“弊”，意思相同，网站从教材。

lines.zh: 田家少闲月，五月人倍忙。
lines.rhythm: 田家/少闲月，五月/人倍忙
lines.py: tián jiā shǎo xián yuè, wǔ yuè rén bèi máng
lines.lit: Farm families have few idle months; in the fifth month people are twice as busy.
lines.en: Farmers rarely have a quiet month, and in the fifth month they work twice as hard.

lines.zh: 夜来南风起，小麦覆陇黄。
lines.rhythm: 夜来/南风起，小麦/覆陇黄
lines.py: yè lái nán fēng qǐ, xiǎo mài fù lǒng huáng
lines.lit: In the night the south wind rose; the wheat covers the ridges, yellow.
lines.en: A south wind blew all night, and by morning the ridges are gold with wheat.

lines.zh: 妇姑荷箪食，童稚携壶浆。
lines.rhythm: 妇姑/荷箪食，童稚/携壶浆
lines.py: fù gū hè dān sì, tóng zhì xié hú jiāng
lines.lit: Wives and mothers-in-law carry baskets of food; children bring jugs of drink.
lines.en: Women shoulder baskets of rice, children carry jugs of broth,
lines.tts: 妇姑贺箪饲，童稚携壶浆。

lines.zh: 相随饷田去，丁壮在南冈。
lines.rhythm: 相随/饷田去，丁壮/在南冈
lines.py: xiāng suí xiǎng tián qù, dīng zhuàng zài nán gāng
lines.lit: Together they go to bring food to the fields; the strong men are on the southern slope.
lines.en: walking together to feed the reapers, the strong men out on the southern slope.

lines.zh: 足蒸暑土气，背灼炎天光。
lines.rhythm: 足蒸/暑土气，背灼/炎天光
lines.py: zú zhēng shǔ tǔ qì, bèi zhuó yán tiān guāng
lines.lit: Feet steamed by the hot earth’s vapour, backs burned by the blazing sky’s light.
lines.en: The hot ground steams their feet, the fierce sun burns their backs.

lines.zh: 力尽不知热，但惜夏日长。
lines.rhythm: 力尽/不知热，但惜/夏日长
lines.py: lì jìn bù zhī rè, dàn xī xià rì cháng
lines.lit: Strength used up, they do not feel the heat; they only value the long summer day.
lines.en: Worn out, they no longer feel the heat — they only wish the long day longer.

lines.zh: 复有贫妇人，抱子在其旁。
lines.rhythm: 复有/贫妇人，抱子/在其旁
lines.py: fù yǒu pín fù rén, bào zǐ zài qí páng
lines.lit: There is also a poor woman, holding a child, at their side.
lines.en: And there beside them, a poor woman with a baby in her arms:

lines.zh: 右手秉遗穗，左臂悬敝筐。
lines.rhythm: 右手/秉遗穗，左臂/悬敝筐
lines.py: yòu shǒu bǐng yí suì, zuǒ bì xuán bì kuāng
lines.lit: Her right hand holds left-behind ears of grain; from her left arm hangs a broken basket.
lines.en: her right hand clutches fallen ears of wheat, a broken basket hangs from her left arm.

lines.zh: 听其相顾言，闻者为悲伤。
lines.rhythm: 听其/相顾言，闻者/为悲伤
lines.py: tīng qí xiāng gù yán, wén zhě wèi bēi shāng
lines.lit: Listening to what she says to them, those who hear grieve because of it.
lines.en: When she speaks to the others, everyone who hears her grieves.
lines.tts: 听其相顾言，闻者位悲伤。

lines.zh: 家田输税尽，拾此充饥肠。
lines.rhythm: 家田/输税尽，拾此/充饥肠
lines.py: jiā tián shū shuì jìn, shí cǐ chōng jī cháng
lines.lit: “Our family’s fields all went to pay taxes; I pick up these to fill a hungry belly.”
lines.en: “Our whole crop went in taxes — I glean these to keep from starving.”

lines.zh: 今我何功德，曾不事农桑。
lines.rhythm: 今我/何功德，曾不/事农桑
lines.py: jīn wǒ hé gōng dé, céng bù shì nóng sāng
lines.lit: Now what merit do I have? I have never worked at farming or silk.
lines.en: And I — what have I done to deserve it? I have never ploughed a field or tended a silkworm,

lines.zh: 吏禄三百石，岁晏有余粮。
lines.rhythm: 吏禄/三百石，岁晏/有余粮
lines.py: lì lù sān bǎi dàn, suì yàn yǒu yú liáng
lines.lit: An official’s pay of three hundred dan; at year’s end there is grain to spare.
lines.en: yet my pay is three hundred measures of grain, and at year’s end I still have some left.
lines.tts: 吏禄三百担，岁晏有余粮。

lines.zh: 念此私自愧，尽日不能忘。
lines.rhythm: 念此/私自愧，尽日/不能忘
lines.py: niàn cǐ sī zì kuì, jìn rì bù néng wàng
lines.lit: Thinking of this, I am secretly ashamed; all day I cannot forget it.
lines.en: The thought shames me, and all day long I cannot let it go.

words.note: 古语，现代汉语说“割”，如“割麦子”。
同“垄”，现代汉语写作“田垄”。
古义：“姑”指婆婆（丈夫的母亲），今天“姑”多指爸爸的姐妹。
读 hè，今天还有“荷枪实弹”“负荷”。

words.en: food carried in a bamboo basket
words.note: “箪”是圆形竹篮；成语“箪食壶浆”原指百姓带饭送水慰劳军队。

words.en: a jug of drink (soup, tea or water)
to bring meals to people working in the fields
words.note: 古义：“饷”是送饭；今天“军饷”指军人的薪水。
书面语，今天还有“秉烛夜谈”“秉公办事”。

words.en: ears of grain left behind after reaping
words.note: “遗”是丢下、落下，“穗”今天说“麦穗”。
“敝”是破旧，今天有成语“敝帚自珍”。
古义：“输”是交纳、送出，今天多指“输赢”“运输”。
古代男耕女织，“桑”指种桑养蚕。

words.en: dan, a measure of grain (about 60 litres in Tang times)
words.note: 作容量单位读 dàn，今天一般不用了。
古语，“晏”是晚；现代汉语说“年底”。

imagery.name: 禾
imagery.zh: 一夜变黄的麦子是全家的希望，也是赋税的来源：农民辛苦种出来，最后却交了税，自己吃不上。
imagery.en: The ripe wheat is the family’s hope — and the tax collector’s share: the people who grow it end up gleaning scraps.

imagery.name: 风
imagery.zh: 南风一夜吹黄了麦子，宣告农忙开始，也带来了炎热的夏天。
imagery.en: One night of south wind turns the wheat gold — the signal that the hardest, hottest work of the year has begun.
